reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent actually viewed the exact source, complete parent RGB raw, complete derived RGBA raw, final white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet, native-resolution derived detail regions, and unchanged mod_nailong/assets/reference/naiwa.png; read the prior RGB review, repair receipt and final evidence, then independently verified all hashes, RGB pixel equality, bilinear resized-source-alpha equality, corners and metadata using read-only Python. entries.positive_observation: The complete derived RGBA visibly preserves the approved parent art: an uncapped compact yellow mascot with a high forehead, receding temples, dark-brown side-parted and slicked-back hair, short side/back hair, narrow sideburns and both dark-brown eyebrows. Green-ringed solid black eyes, one restrained serious closed mouth, clean-shaven face, no glasses and no human nose, ears or skin remain. The left-facing near-profile pose, leftward gaze, upright shoulders, crop and directional light are retained. Gold shoulder boards, two red densely gold-embroidered collar patches, narrow pale shirt edge, one black-and-silver throat cross and one gold chest eagle remain without duplicated insignia. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, pinching, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. The pale warm gray-beige mottled backplate remains complete through the original rectangle, with no headgear, frame, note, halo or replacement backdrop.
entries.alpha_decision: The existing derived repair is accepted, not represented as a native transparent return. Read-only recomputation confirmed that the parent RGB pixels and derived RGB channels are identical, and that the source alpha resized with BILINEAR exactly equals the derived alpha; resized alpha raw-byte SHA-256 is 11e122a90e29c4446b6c237e34e49cbf168d719980366098d97c5453f58620c1. Source, resized and output corner alpha arrays are all [255,255,255,255]. Source and returned alpha extrema are [255,255], and all 4205568 derived pixels have alpha 255. Actual full white/cyan/alpha viewing shows an intact opaque backplate and solid uniform with no holes, matte, haze, halo or backing loss; cyan strips are sheet letterboxing. No additional repair was performed.
entries.visible_limitations: Individual hair strands, the finest collar embroidery and the neck-cross interior are not fully resolved at 156x210. The visible hairline, feature counts, positions and broad shapes were checked without claiming unreadable micro-detail; those source-resolution limits are not rejection grounds.
